children.text: Our academic program is built upon a structured daily schedule that fosters active, student-centered learning and critical thinking, supported by differentiated instruction tailored to diverse needs.

Our well-resourced library serves as a hub for research and literacy development, while hands-on STEM initiatives encourage innovation and problem-solving. Through our inclusive education framework, every learner receives the support necessary to thrive within the rigor of the American curriculum from kindergarten through grade 12.

image.alt: SAIS - UAQ students learning with a microscope

children.text: Comprehensive career guidance and counseling services help students chart their academic and professional pathways, and our Acceptable Use and Devices policies ensure responsible, safe integration of technology in the classroom.

Regular assessments including MAP, CAT4, and other benchmark tests, provide actionable insights into student progress, informing personalized instruction and upholding our commitment to academic excellence.

heading.title: Guiding Every Step  of the Student Journey

image.alt: SAIS - UAQ students connecting with Emirati culture

children.text: Each member in our highly qualified teaching staff holds advanced degrees, nationally or internationally recognized certifications, and extensive classroom experience. We invest continuously in their growth through a robust professional development program comprising subject-area workshops, instructional coaching, technology integration training, collaborative learning communities, data-driven seminars, accreditation workshops, and peer-observation cycles; so that every educator remains at the forefront of best practices in pedagogy, curriculum design, and student support.

This sustained commitment to ongoing professional learning ensures that every classroom is led by a teacher prepared to meet the diverse needs of our students and maintain the highest standards of excellence.

We believe that guiding students through their academic and career journeys is essential for their long-term success. Our dedicated Career and Guidance Counselor provides a comprehensive support program that focuses on students' academic, personal, and post-secondary development.

image.alt: SAIS - UAQ students playing maracas in music class

children.text: We provide regular sessions with both students and parents, ensuring transparency and support at every stage of the journey. Our counselor also assists students in registering and preparing for college entrance exams such as the SAT and helps coordinate Advanced Placement (AP) enrollment for eligible students.

When it comes to university applications, the counselor takes a hands-on role supporting students in crafting personal statements, selecting appropriate universities, writing compelling college essays, and meeting all application deadlines. We also provide official recommendation letters that reflect each student's strengths and character.

image.alt: SAIS - UAQ students laughing together at lunch

children.text: Our team is committed to connecting our students with opportunities beyond the classroom. Our campus regularly hosts university fairs and college visits, giving students a chance to explore global academic institutions and make informed decisions. We also maintain close communication with universities to stay up to date on evolving admissions requirements and ensure our students are well-prepared.
Our ultimate goal is to empower students with the skills, information, and confidence they need to thrive in higher education and in life.

image.alt: SAIS - UAQ teacher guiding young students through a maths activity

children.text: Our holistic approach nurtures each student’s intellectual, emotional, and social growth through programs that build leadership, resilience, empathy, and intercultural understanding. Whether preparing students for university admissions, careers in innovation, or civic engagement, the SAIS curriculum ensures they graduate as confident, well-rounded individuals ready to thrive in the 21st century.

We believe that exceptional education is built upon meaningful learning experiences that inspire students to think deeply, grow confidently, and engage purposefully with the world around them. Our curriculum is designed to be dynamic, student-centered, and future-focused, ensuring that every learner is challenged academically while also supported socially and emotionally. Through active learning, inquiry-based instruction, and authentic real-world connections, students develop the key skills necessary for lifelong success, including critical and creative thinking, communication and collaboration, and organization and self-management. We encourage students to become independent learners who can analyze, innovate, communicate effectively, and take ownership of their learning while building the confidence to navigate challenges and opportunities in an ever-changing global society.

image.alt: SAIS - UAQ students working in a science lab

children.text: At the heart of SAIS - UAQ is a commitment to nurturing well-rounded individuals who embody the dispositions needed to thrive both academically and personally. Our curriculum intentionally cultivates resilience and adaptability, empathy, curiosity, and a growth mindset through engaging learning environments, meaningful relationships, and purposeful educational experiences. We believe that curriculum, instruction, and assessment are interconnected elements of a holistic learning journey that empowers students to grow intellectually, emotionally, and socially. Through differentiated instruction, collaborative learning opportunities, and strong student support systems, we guide learners to discover their strengths, embrace challenges positively, and contribute meaningfully to their communities.

Our vision is to develop compassionate, confident, and globally minded students who are prepared not only for academic achievement, but also for leadership, innovation, and lifelong success in a rapidly evolving world.

image.alt: SAIS - UAQ students working on an art and craft activity

children.text: We prepare students for international standardized tests such as the SAT, IELTS, and AP. We also integrate advanced educational technologies, fostering 21st-century skills through the use of interactive learning tools, digital platforms, and innovation-based teaching strategies.

cards.description:
The Cognitive Abilities Test (CAT4) helps us understand how students learn and their academic potential. Students in Grades 3-9 take this assessment upon enrollment to identify their learning styles, enabling teachers to:

•	Adapt teaching approaches and materials
•	Adjust instructional pace and emphasis
•	Implement differentiated instruction

CAT4 measures four types of reasoning:

•	Verbal Reasoning - Understanding and reasoning through words
•	Quantitative Reasoning - Using numerical skills for problem-solving
•	Non-verbal Reasoning - Problem-solving using visual information
•	Spatial Ability - Thinking and drawing conclusions in three dimensions

image.alt: SAIS - UAQ student during CAT4 assessment

•	Produce accurate data about each student’s learning level
•	Identify areas of strength and opportunity
•	Measure overall performance in core subjects
